example: The warm tea made me feel drowsy.
note_say: The stress is on the first syllable. The first part rhymes with how.
ex_say: The warm tea made me feel drowsy.
tip: On medicine labels: "may cause drowsiness" (may make you sleepy).
vn_tip: “drow” đọc như “drao”, không phải “drô”. Âm sau là /z/, không phải /s/.
vn_tip_say: Drow sounds like the word how, not like row. Then a Z sound: drowsy.
